description.value: Qaayuuk Fishing and Lodge is an Indigenous-owned floating wilderness lodge nestled in the pristine waters of Kyuquot Sound on Vancouver Island's remote west coast, owned and operated by Russell Hanson since 2024. The 10-bedroom lodge accommodates up to 18 guests and offers guided salmon and halibut fishing, locally sourced seafood meals, and access via a 30-minute water taxi ride from Fair Harbour or direct floatplane to the dock. It represents a rare opportunity to experience deep wilderness hospitality rooted in generations of commercial fishing expertise.
